intro_title: Turn a photo or clip into a verified observation
intro_body: YA-WAMF uses the same model, crop selection, and video consensus as live detections. Nothing is added until you review it.

evidence.species_frame_help: The best frame of {species}, {time} into the video. This becomes the observation's photo.
evidence.species_frame_help_untimed: The best frame of {species} in the video. This becomes the observation's photo.
evidence.no_species_frame_help: No frame singled out {species}, so the observation keeps the first frame of the video as its photo.
evidence.first_frame_help: The first frame of the video.
evidence.photo_help: Your photo, kept as uploaded. The classifier scored the whole frame.
evidence.photo_cropped_help: Your photo, kept as uploaded. The classifier scored a crop around the bird.

errors.load: The analysis status could not be loaded.
errors.type: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MOV, or WebM file.
errors.image_size: Choose an image no larger than 25 MB.
errors.video_size: Choose a video no larger than 250 MB.
errors.upload: The media could not be uploaded.
errors.retry: The analysis could not be restarted.
errors.save: The observation could not be saved.

upload.title: Choose a photo or video
upload.help: Use the original file when possible. YA-WAMF will preserve it and choose the strongest input for classification.
upload.drop: Drop media here or choose a file
upload.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 25 MB · MP4, MOV, WebM up to 250 MB / 3 minutes

analysis.title: Finding the strongest evidence
analysis.body: The production classifier is comparing frames and crop candidates. You can leave this page; the draft will be restored when you return.
analysis.failed_body: Your original media is still stored. Retry when the model is available.

review.title: Review before saving
review.body: Confirm the suggested species, correct it if needed, and add the field context you want to keep.
review.several_species: Each suggestion shows the bird it was scored on. If the video has more than one bird, choose the one this observation is for and its photo follows.
review.when_help: Leave empty to use the time you save it.
review.when_help_from_photo: Read from the photo's own metadata. Change it if the camera clock was wrong.
review.when_help_from_video: Read from the video's own metadata. Change it if the camera clock was wrong.
review.when_help_file_fallback: Leave empty to use the time saved in the file.
review.when_help_none: No capture time was found in the file. Leave empty to use the time you save it.
review.species_unknown: Not a species this model knows; it will be saved as typed.
review.species_help: Choose a suggestion above, or search by common or scientific name.

location.title: Sighting location
location.extracted: Location found in the image metadata. Check the pin and adjust it if needed.
location.missing: No embedded location was found. Place a pin if you know where the sighting was made.
location.manual: This pin was placed or adjusted manually. Check it before saving.
location.map_label: Map for placing the sighting pin
location.map_help: Click or tap the map to place the pin. Drag it to make a precise adjustment.
location.incomplete: Enter both latitude and longitude, or clear the location.
location.invalid: Latitude must be −90 to 90 and longitude −180 to 180.
location.pin_label: Sighting location pin; drag to adjust

saved.title: Observation saved
saved.body: The verified record is now part of your detection history and species totals.

bar.hint: Nothing is added until you review it

discard.title: Discard this upload?
discard.message: The uploaded file and its analysis are deleted. Nothing has been added to your observations.

duplicate.saved: This file is already saved as an observation.
duplicate.draft: This file was uploaded before and is still waiting for your review.
